brief:
Yosef Jabareen, head of the Joint List and Knesset member, declared the faction's readiness to facilitate the removal of the Netanyahu–Ben Gvir–Smotrich government at the earliest opportunity, the Ma'an news agency reported. Jabareen characterized the current phase as an "emergency state" for all citizens.

The statement signals the Joint List's positioning amid ongoing political tensions in Israel, where the coalition government has faced mounting criticism over its policies and conduct.
